notes: This file is a shipped placeholder, not a moderation decision. The entries below only demonstrate the two match modes.
Before any event that publishes attendee names, replace entries with a reviewed list, record the reviewer and date, set placeholder to false, and cite the source.
Prefer vendoring an attributed, maintained public list over writing one here, and have a human owner accept it.
Use match "substring" only for terms that are never part of an innocent word, because substring matching rejects every name containing the fragment.
Use match "word" for anything that appears inside ordinary words, so a name like Classic Mona Cold Brew is not rejected.
Matching folds digits to letters, removes spaces, hyphens and apostrophes, and collapses repeated characters, so do not add spaced, doubled or leetspeak spellings of a term you already list.
